title: Copilot Notebooks: audio overview gains topic episodes, Critique and Debate formats and label support
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts and existing Notebooks controls are supported, and the page reports the conflicting Microsoft licensing and storage documentation. The preview Graph control note should explicitly name the request-body properties that apply the setting.

claims.fix: Keep the call unchanged. In controls[0].note and the rendered row note, replace 'API: preview TCM applyOnce, resourceType microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, value 0 or 1.' with 'API: preview TCM; request body sets mode to applyOnce and baseline.resources[].resourceType to microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks, resourceVersion to 1, and properties.value to the string 0 (disable) or 1 (enable).' References: https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta and https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The TCM Copilot resource documentation and Graph operation are preview/beta.
claims.quote: This article lists the Copilot resource types supported in preview for monitoring and snapshots through the Tenant Configuration Management (TCM) APIs in Microsoft Graph beta.

claims.claim: The baseline resource type for the Pages and Notebooks setting is microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks"

claims.claim: The TCM baseline resource uses resourceVersion 1.
claims.quote: All resources on this page use resourceVersion: 1 and are singletons.

claims.claim: Setting properties.value to the string 0 disables the Pages and Notebooks setting.
claims.quote: The value property is a string, not a Boolean or a number. ... 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting.

claims.claim: Setting properties.value to the string 1 enables the Pages and Notebooks setting.
claims.quote: "properties": { "value": "1" } ... 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting.

claims.claim: TCM supports these Copilot Cloud Policy settings only in tenant-level policies.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: TCM applyOnce fails for a resource if its target setting is configured in a group-level policy.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: AI Administrator is the least-privileged signed-in user role for applying this setting through TCM.
claims.quote: For remediation and applyOnce, AI Administrator is the least-privileged Microsoft Entra role for the signed-in user. This role requirement applies to the user, not to the TCM service principal.

claims.claim: The calling app needs delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All permission for an applyOnce monitor.
claims.quote: Creating an applyOnce monitor supports delegated permissions only. In addition to the calling app's delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All permission, the TCM service principal needs delegated permissions for the target workloads

claims.claim: The TCM service principal needs delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite permission for applyOnce.
claims.quote: For remediation and applyOnce, grant it the CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite delegated permission.

claims.claim: A new or changed Cloud Policy configuration can take up to 90 minutes to be reflected when prior configurations existed.
claims.quote: If there were existing policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 90 minutes to be reflected.

claims.claim: A Cloud Policy configuration change can take up to 24 hours to be reflected when no prior configurations existed.
claims.quote: If there were no policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 24 hours to be reflected.

claims.claim: Audio overview files saved to OneDrive fall within the documented retention-policy and retention-label scope for files.
claims.quote: All files stored in SharePoint (and SharePoint Embedded) or OneDrive sites can be retained by applying a retention policy or retention label.

claims.claim: The September 3, 2025 release notes document saving a generated Copilot Notebooks audio overview to OneDrive.
claims.quote: Save the audio overview that you have generated within a Copilot Notebook to OneDrive so you can download or share with others.

claims.claim: Copilot Notebooks create and update .pod files.
claims.quote: Copilot Notebooks create and update .pod files to manage content.
